By now Andrew Walcott had arrived and was drafted into both events. It needed Kevin Brown in the sprint relay and Ian Wells, who was still recovering from a broken foot (obtained while warm weather training, so no sympathy from the Team Management), to complete the squads.

Iwan Thomas was a close third just ahead of Andrew Walcott who was showing a late season return to form. In the 10000m Jim Estall, fresh from holiday and claiming to be unfit, had a good tussle with former record holder Julian Goater and moved our point score along nicely.
